description: fts-troubleshooting.md's tf-idf scoreFn formula FAQ presents tf-idf as the Search Service's scoring mechanism, with no mention of bm25 or the Server 8.0+ index-level scoring-model choice (search:scoring-model) that lets an administrator pick between the two. tf-idf remains bleve's legacy default, so the FAQ isn't wrong, but it reads as though tf-idf is the only option - stale relative to search/set-advanced-settings.md, read in the same product tree one round earlier.
